title: helianthemum glaucum f. stoechadifolium
intro: Helianthemum glaucum f. stoechadifolium, commonly known as Rock Rose, is a flowering plant in the family Cistaceae. It is a low-growing, shrub-like plant with fragrant flowers, traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The plant is believed to have health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to soothe skin irritations and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Rock Rose include astringent, anti-inflammatory, and vulnerary properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids.
